display.purpose: The one misregistered hero headline per page. Merriweather 800.

title.purpose: Content titles — post rows, app names, wordmark, subscribe line. Merriweather 700.

body.purpose: Intro and body copy (17px); dek is the 15px secondary-ink variant. Inter 400.

label.purpose: Eyebrows, meta lines, status pills. Inter 600, uppercase, 0.14em tracking.

motion.name: hover-color
motion.purpose: Link, heading, and nav hover shift to brand-bright. The only recurring transition.

breakpoints.name: mobile
breakpoints.purpose: Two-column rail+main collapses to a single stacked column.

breakpoints.name: mobile-sm
breakpoints.purpose: Type-only step; shrinks the hero from 34px to 30px.

accessibility.name: reduced-transparency
accessibility.purpose: Hides the misregistration ghost and halftone; blend effects drop to solid ink.

accessibility.name: increased-contrast
accessibility.purpose: Same gate as reduced-transparency — meaning never depends on a blend mode.

components.name: Monogram
components.description: The identity mark — a magenta ink square with a misregistered teal ghost behind it.
components.css: .ds-monogram { position: relative; width: 46px; height: 46px; } .ds-monogram-ghost, .ds-monogram-ink { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 46px; height: 46px; border-radius: 2px; } .ds-monogram-ghost { transform: translate(3px, 3px); background: var(--color-teal); mix-blend-mode: multiply; } .ds-monogram-ink { background: var(--color-brand); color: var(--color-paper); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: Merriweather, Georgia, serif; font-weight: 900; font-size: 22px; }

components.name: New Tag
components.description: Marks the newest post. Magenta fill, paper text, tiny uppercase.
components.css: .ds-tag-new { display: inline-block; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-paper); background: var(--color-brand); padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 2px; }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Dot + uppercase label. Color plus text — never color alone. Live (green) / WIP (ochre).
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-status-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-status-live { color: var(--color-positive); } .ds-status-live .ds-status-dot { background: var(--color-positive); }

components.name: Nav Item
components.description: Rail navigation. Serif, a magenta arrow marker on the active item, brand-bright on hover.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 10px; font-family: Merriweather, Georgia, serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 19px; line-height: 1.15; color: var(--color-ink); text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.15s ease; } .ds-nav-marker { display: inline-block; width: 12px; flex-shrink: 0; color: var(--color-brand); font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; } .ds-nav-item:hover, .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { color: var(--color-brand-bright); }

components.name: Registration Mark
components.description: The connective print motif — teal crosshair + magenta ring. Variants: full / cross / ring.

components.css: .ds-post { display: block; padding: 22px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-hairline); text-decoration: none; } .ds-post-meta { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 9px; } .ds-label { font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-ink-secondary); } .ds-post-sep { color: var(--color-hairline); font-size: 11px; } .ds-post-tag { font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-paper); background: var(--color-brand); padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 2px; } .ds-post-title { margin: 0; font-family: Merriweather, Georgia, serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 21px; line-height: 1.28; color: var(--color-ink); transition: color 0.15s ease; } .ds-post:hover .ds-post-title { color: var(--color-brand-bright); } .ds-post-dek { margin: 7px 0 0; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.53; color: var(--color-ink-secondary); max-width: 440px; }

components.name: Hero Misregistration
components.description: The one loud print moment — a headline riding a 3px magenta ghost in multiply. The ghost hides under the accessibility gate.
components.html:
Making small, sharp software.

components.css: .ds-hero-title { position: relative; max-width: 760px; } .ds-hero-ink, .ds-hero-ghost { margin: 0; font-family: Merriweather, Georgia, serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 56px; line-height: 1.1; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-hero-ghost { position: absolute; inset: 0; transform: translate(3px, 3px); color: var(--color-brand); mix-blend-mode: multiply; z-index: -1; pointer-events: none; } @media (prefers-reduced-transparency: reduce), (prefers-contrast: more) { .ds-hero-ghost { display: none; } }

components.name: Halftone Dot Field
components.description: Teal dot screen that fades out radially near a hero. Decorative only; multiply on light, screen on dark. Shown on a bone backing so the blend reads.
components.css: .ds-halftone-demo { display: inline-block; padding: 12px; background: var(--color-paper); } .ds-halftone { width: 320px; height: 200px; background-image: radial-gradient(var(--color-teal) 1.1px, transparent 1.5px); background-size: 7px 7px; mix-blend-mode: multiply; -webkit-mask-image: radial-gradient(120% 120% at 92% 8%, #000 0%, rgba(0,0,0,.5) 34%, transparent 68%); mask-image: radial-gradient(120% 120% at 92% 8%, #000 0%, rgba(0,0,0,.5) 34%, transparent 68%); } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-halftone { mix-blend-mode: screen; } }

components.name: Riso-Duotone Photo
components.description: The treatment for real photography — grayscale piped through an ink/paper duotone filter (SVG, defined once in Base.astro), then the halftone dot recipe laid full-bleed over the top. A photo run through the same press as everything else.
components.css: .ds-riso-photo { margin: 0; position: relative; border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-riso-photo-img { width: 280px; height: 180px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--color-ink), var(--color-paper)); } .ds-riso-photo::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background-image: radial-gradient(var(--color-teal) 1.1px, transparent 1.5px); background-size: 7px 7px; mix-blend-mode: multiply; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-riso-photo::after { mix-blend-mode: screen; } }

narrative.overview: A proof sheet is the test pull a printer takes off the press to check registration and ink before the real run — the sheet where the craft is right there to see. That's this system: two spot inks, magenta and teal, on a warm bone ground, printed slightly out of register. The constraint is the point: with only two colors you solve hierarchy with weight, size, and space instead of reaching for a third. Restraint is the method, not an absence of ideas; "the craft is the credential." The feel is quiet, exact, crafted, and warmly personal — a working notebook, not a marketing site. Generous bone whitespace, a two-column rail+main layout, content in hairline-divided rows rather than cards, and one loud moment per page: the misregistered hero headline.
keyCharacteristics: Two inks, one ground — magenta + teal over bone paper, no third accent ever.
Serif prints, sans functions — Merriweather for anything printed, Inter for anything operational.
Flat by tone, not shadow — depth from paper/surface/surface-raised layering and hairlines.
One loud moment — the misregistered headline is spent once per page.
Accessibility-gated ink — blend effects degrade to solid ink; meaning never depends on a blend.

rules.name: The Two-Ink Rule
rules.body: Every screen prints in exactly two inks — magenta and teal — over one bone ground. No third accent; hierarchy is weight, size, and space. Teal is the rarer ink: halftone, ghost, and registration marks only.

rules.name: The Token Rule
rules.body: Dark values are theme-aware by default. Never hardcode a light value where a token exists — the token already carries its dark twin.

rules.name: The Printed-Heading Rule
rules.body: Serif (Merriweather) is reserved for what should read as printed — display, headings, titles, wordmark. Sans (Inter) carries everything functional. The two are never swapped.

rules.name: The Single-Impression Rule
rules.body: By default, the misregistration is spent once per page — on the single most important headline. Its power is scarcity: a second offset headline of equal weight halves the impact of both. Break it only on purpose — a distinct page type, or a spread where a second region genuinely earns its own loud moment — never as decoration or reflex. The test: if you can't say what the second impression is for, it stays in register.

rules.name: The Flat Press Rule
rules.body: Surfaces never lift off the page. Separate things by tonal layer or a hairline, never a shadow. The only apparent offset allowed is the misregistration, and that is ink, not elevation.

dos: Do reuse an existing token before adding a new one; if nothing fits, add it here and to global.css together.
Do set anything printed in Merriweather and anything functional in Inter.
Do let new page types break from the two-column layout, but keep the same palette, type scale, and signature motifs — "different structure, same ink."
Do check both color schemes and the accessibility gates before calling an illustrated component done.
Do pair every status color with a text label — color is never the only signal.
donts: Don't introduce a third ink or accent color.
Don't add box-shadows, glows, or glassmorphism — the system is flat.
Don't scatter the misregistration across headlines by reflex — spend it once by default (see The Single-Impression Rule), and never let meaning depend on a blend mode.
Don't hardcode a light color value where a token exists.
Don't build a generic SaaS/startup landing: gradient hero, feature grid, "Get started free."
Don't add salesy-funnel patterns — pop-ups, urgency, subscribe-walls, growth hacks.
Don't flatten this into a sterile minimalist portfolio grid with no point of view, and don't go loud or maximalist.
Don't use a colored border-left/right stripe as an accent, or gradient text.
